an8.22:1.1: ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā vajjīsu viharati hatthigāme.
an8.22:1.3: aṭṭhahi bhikkhave, acchariyehi abbhutehi dhammehi samannāgataṃ uggaṃ gahapatiṃ hatthigāmakaṃ dhārethā’ti.
an8.22:1.5: idaṃ vatvā sugato uṭṭhāyāsanā vihāraṃ pāvisi.
an8.22:2.1: atha kho aññataro bhikkhu pubbanhasamayaṃ nivāsetvā pattacīvaramādāya yena uggassa gahapatino hatthigāmakassa nivesanaṃ tenupasaṅkami. upasaṅkamitvā paññatte āsane nisīdi.
an8.22:2.2: atha kho uggo gahapati hatthigāmako yena so bhikkhu tenupasaṅkami. upasaṅkamitvā taṃ bhikkhuṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. ekamantaṃ nisinnaṃ kho uggaṃ gahapatiṃ hatthigāmakaṃ so bhikkhu etadavoca:
an8.22:2.3: aṭṭhahi kho tvaṃ gahapati, acchariyehi abbhutehi dhammehi samannāgato bhagavatā vyākato.
an8.22:2.4: katame te gahapati, aṭṭha acchariyā abbhutā dhammā yehi tvaṃ samannāgato bhagavatā vyākatoti?
an8.22:3.2: katamehipahaṃ aṭṭhahi acchariyehi abbhutehi dhammehi samannāgato bhagavatā vyākato.
an8.22:3.3: apica bhante, ye me aṭṭha acchariyā abbhutā dhammā saṃvijjanti
an8.22:3.5: evaṃ gahapatīti so bhikkhu uggassa gahapatino hatthigāmakassa paccassosi.
an8.22:3.7: yadāhaṃ bhante, nāgavane paricārento bhagavantaṃ paṭhamaṃ dūratova addasaṃ.
an8.22:3.8: sahadassaneneva me bhante, bhagavato cittaṃ pasīdi. surāmado ca pahīyi.
an8.22:3.9: ayaṃ kho me bhante, paṭhamo acchariyo abbhuto dhammo saṃvijjati.
an8.22:4.1: so kho ahaṃ bhante, pasannacitto bhagavantaṃ payirupāsiṃ.
an8.22:4.2: tassa me bhagavā ānupubbīkathaṃ kathesi, seyyathīdaṃ:
an8.22:4.3: dānakathaṃ sīlakathaṃ saggakathaṃ kāmānaṃ ādīnavaṃ okāraṃ saṅkilesaṃ nekkhamme ca ānisaṃsaṃ pakāsesi.
an8.22:4.4: yadā maṃ bhagavā aññāsi kallacittaṃ muducittaṃ vinīvaraṇacittaṃ udaggacittaṃ pasannacittaṃ atha yā buddhānaṃ sāmukkaṃsikā dhammadesanā taṃ pakāsesi.
an8.22:4.6: seyyathāpi nāma suddhaṃ vatthaṃ apagatakāḷakaṃ sammadeva rajanaṃ patigaṇheyya,
an8.22:4.7: evameva kho tasmiṃ yeva āsane virajaṃ vītamalaṃ dhammacakkhuṃ udapādi,
an8.22:4.8: yaṃ kiñci samudayadhammaṃ sabbaṃ taṃ nirodhadhammanti.
an8.22:4.9: so kho ahaṃ bhante, diṭṭhadhammo pattadhammo viditadhammo pariyogāḷhadhammo tiṇṇavicikiccho vigatakathaṃkatho vesārajjappatto aparappaccayo satthusāsane tattheva buddhaṃ ca dhammaṃ ca saṅghaṃ ca saraṇaṃ agamāsiṃ. brahmacariyapañcamāni ca sikkhāpadāni samādiyiṃ.
an8.22:4.10: ayaṃ kho me bhante, dutiyo acchariyo abbhuto dhammo saṃvijjati.
an8.22:5.1: tassa mayhaṃ bhante, catasso komāriyo pajāpatiyo ahesuṃ.
an8.22:5.2: atha khvāhaṃ bhante, yena tā pajāpatiyo tenupasaṅkamiṃ. upasaṅkamitvā tā pajāpatiyo etadavocaṃ:
an8.22:5.3: mayā kho bhaginiyo brahmacariyapañcamāni sikkhāpadāni samādinnāni.
an8.22:5.4: yā icchati sā idheva bhoge ca bhuñjatu! puññāni ca karotu! sakāni vā ñātikulāni gacchatu!
an8.22:5.5: hoti vā pana purisādhippāyā, kassa vo dammīti.
an8.22:5.6: evaṃ vutte sā bhante jeṭṭhā pajāpatī maṃ etadavoca:
an8.22:5.8: atha khvāhaṃ bhante, taṃ purisaṃ pakkosāpetvā vāmena hatthena pajāpatiṃ gahetvā dakkhiṇena hatthena bhiṅkāraṃ gahetvā tassa purisassa onojesiṃ.
an8.22:5.9: komāriṃ kho panāhaṃ bhante, dāraṃ pariccajanno nābhijānāmi cittassa aññathattaṃ.
an8.22:5.10: ayaṃ kho me bhante, tatiyo acchariyo abbhuto dhammo saṃvijjati.
an8.22:6.1: saṃvijjanti kho pana me bhante, kule bhogā
an8.22:6.2: te ca kho appaṭivibhattā sīlavantehi kalyāṇadhammehi.
an8.22:6.3: ayaṃ kho me bhante, catuttho acchariyo abbhuto dhammo saṃvijjati.
an8.22:7.1: yaṃ kho panāhaṃ bhante, bhikkhuṃ payirupāsāmi,
an8.22:7.3: so ce me bhante, āyasmā dhammaṃ deseti
an8.22:7.5: no ce me so āyasmā dhammaṃ deseti, ahamassa dhammaṃ desemi.
an8.22:7.6: ayaṃ kho me bhante, pañcamo acchariyo abbhuto dhammo saṃvijjati.
an8.22:8.1: anacchariyaṃ kho pana me bhante, saṅghe nimantite devatā upasaṅkamitvā ārocenti:
an8.22:8.2: asuko gahapati, bhikkhu ubhatobhāgavimutto, asuko paññāvimutto, asuko kāyasakkhī, asuko diṭṭhappatto asuko saddhāvimutto, asuko saddhānusārī, asuko dhammānusārī, asuko sīlavā kalyāṇadhammo, asuko dussīlo pāpadhammoti.
an8.22:8.3: saṅghaṃ kho panāhaṃ bhante, parivisanto nābhijānāmi. evaṃ cittaṃ uppādetā:
an8.22:8.4: imassa vā thokaṃ demi imassa vā bahukanti.
an8.22:8.6: ayaṃ kho me bhante, chaṭṭho acchariyo abbhuto dhammo saṃvijjati.
an8.22:9.1: acchariyaṃ kho pana me bhante, devatā upasaṅkamitvā ārocenti:
an8.22:9.3: evaṃ vutte ahaṃ bhante, tā devatā evaṃ vadāmi.
an8.22:9.4: ‘vadeyyātha vā evaṃ kho tumhe devatā no vā vadeyyātha, atha kho svākkhāto bhagavatā dhammo’ ti.
an8.22:9.5: na kho panāhaṃ bhante, abhijānāmi tato nidānaṃ cittassa uṇṇatiṃ.
an8.22:9.6: maṃ vā devatā upasaṅkamanti. ahaṃ vā devatāhi sallapāmīti.
an8.22:9.7: ayaṃ kho me bhante, sattamo acchariyo abbhuto dhammo saṃvijjati.
an8.22:10.1: sace kho panāhaṃ bhante, bhagavato paṭhamataraṃ kālaṅkareyyaṃ anacchariyaṃ kho panetaṃ yaṃ maṃ bhagavā evaṃ vyākareyya;
an8.22:10.2: natthi taṃ saṃyojanaṃ yena saṃyojanena saṃyutto uggo gahapati hatthigāmako puna imaṃ lokaṃ āgaccheyyāti.
an8.22:10.3: ayaṃ kho me bhante, aṭṭhamo acchariyo abbhuto dhammo saṃvijjati.
an8.22:11.1: ime kho bhante, aṭṭha acchariyā abbhutā dhammā saṃvijjanti.
an8.22:11.3: katamehipahaṃ aṭṭhahi acchariyehi abbhutehi dhammehi samannāgato bhagavatā vyākatoti.
an8.22:12.1: atha kho so bhikkhu uggassa gahapatino hatthigāmakassa nivesane piṇḍapātaṃ gahetvā uṭṭhāyāsanā pakkāmi.
an8.22:12.2: atha kho so bhikkhu pacchābhattaṃ piṇḍapātapaṭikkanto yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami. upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi.
an8.22:12.3: ekamantaṃ nisinno kho so bhikkhu yāvatako ahosi uggena gahapatinā hatthigāmakena saddhiṃ kathāsallāppo, taṃ sabbaṃ bhagavato ārocesi.
an8.22:13.2: yathā taṃ uggo gahapati hatthigāmako sammā vyākaramāno vyākareyya imeheva kho bhikkhu, aṭṭhahi acchariyehi abbhutehi dhammehi samannāgato uggo gahapati hatthigāmako mayā vyākato.
an8.22:13.3: imehi ca pana bhikkhu aṭṭhahi acchariyehi abbhutehi dhammehi samannāgataṃ uggaṃ gahapatiṃ hatthigāmakaṃ dhārethāti.
